rows.bname: จำนวนโรงเรียนทั้งหมดตามบริบทงานอนามัยโรงเรียน
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c:=(SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx  ENGINE=MyISAM IGNORE AS
SELECT CONCAT(s.SCHOOLID,' : ',s.SCHOOLNAME) SCHOOLNAME,o.OrganizationTypeName
              ,j.JurisdictionName,c.changwatname,a.ampurname,'0000000000000' as cid
							,h.hosname,IF(ISNULL(h.hosname),'ยังไม่พบข้อมูล','Mappingแล้ว') result
	FROM school s  
	INNER JOIN s_school3 s3 ON s.schoolid=s3.schoolid
	INNER JOIN cchangwat c ON SUBSTR(s.SUBDISTRICTCODE,1,2)=c.changwatcode
	INNER JOIN campur a ON SUBSTR(s.SUBDISTRICTCODE,1,4)=a.ampurcodefull   
	LEFT JOIN cjurisdiction j ON s.JURISDICTIONID=j.JurisdictionID 
	LEFT JOIN corganizationtype o ON s.ORGANIZATIONTYPECODE=o.OrganizationTypeID 
	LEFT JOIN chospital h ON s.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE SUBSTR(s.SUBDISTRICTCODE,1,2) IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY s.SCHOOLID;


SELECT
d.SCHOOLNAME,d.OrganizationTypeName,d.JurisdictionName
,d.changwatname,d.ampurname,d.cid,d.hosname,d.result
FROM
tx d WHERE 1=1

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT  c.zone_code as a_code ,c.zone_name as a_name, sum(target) as target ,sum(target-result) as result  FROM school as c INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON c.schoolid=s.schoolid AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} and c.academicyear =s.b_year  WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) and (c."jurisdictionid" = {{JURISDICTION_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{JURISDICTION_CODE}}) GROUP BY c.zone_code,c.zone_name ORDER BY c.zone_code

provider.label: หน่วยบริการ
provider.query: SELECT  CASE WHEN C.hospcode IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(C.hospcode)) = 0 THEN '99999' ELSE C.hospcode END AS a_code, CASE WHEN C.hosname IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(C.hosname)) = 0 THEN '99999:ไม่ระบุ' ELSE CONCAT(C.hospcode, ':', C.hosname) END AS a_name, sum(target) as target ,sum(target-result) as result  FROM school as c INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON c.schoolid=s.schoolid AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} and c.academicyear =s.b_year  WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) and (c."jurisdictionid" = {{JURISDICTION_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{JURISDICTION_CODE}}) GROUP BY a_code,a_name
